# Product notes: Patchpost

Patchpost is a fictional tool. It takes a pasted Git diff and lets a developer
edit a release note before exporting it as Markdown. It does not open pull
requests or publish anything. We have no customers or measured results yet.

The UI is already built with Astro and plain CSS. The logo, colors, and layout
must stay as they are. We want a small landing page in English. There is a
working sample diff in the app, so the action should be "Try a sample diff".

Pricing and supported Git providers are undecided. We have not chosen between
solo open-source maintainers and larger product teams. Make a useful first
draft with clearly stated assumptions. Do not ask me a long questionnaire.
